personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect every coin, gem, relic, key and heart, open every locked door, and finish the level with the time bonus.
personas.style: Uses goto: macros to walk between items, then checks the HUD and state after each pickup. Revisits rooms to confirm collected items stay gone. Tracks coin and key totals against the level's fixed counts (5 coins, keys equal to locked doors).

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or other outcomes early, or by unintended routes: dashing over locked doors and gates, dashing through spikes, swapping tiles with enemies, reaching the exit without the keys, and using levers at odd moments.
personas.style: Tries dash into solid tiles, dash with no recharge, step onto closed gates, and combine dash with pickups along the path. Attempts exit before collecting everything and checks that the level only completes when stepping onto E.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing around transitions: pause, resume, restart, quit and press several keys in one tick while collecting, getting hurt, finishing or at timer zero.
personas.style: Sends combined inputs such as pause+left, dash-right+down, use+enter, and esc during pickups or enemy contact. Spams wait and click:btn-resume in odd orders. Checks that paused ticks change nothing and that one move per tick holds.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, starting from a fresh game with no prior knowledge.
personas.style: Plays only what the document says: starts at (1,1), steps, bumps into walls, opens doors with keys, reads each HUD field and compares it to the wording, and confirms the Dash countdown from 6 to ready. Notes any sentence the game does not match.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins and timer to their limits and verify every amount: score floor at 0, cap at 999,999, lives between 0 and 5, heart bonus at 5 lives, spikes costing 500, timer reset at 0, and time bonus of 10 per tick.
personas.style: Deliberately takes spikes at low score, collects hearts at 5 lives, lets the timer run out, and tracks exact deltas for each item and hazard tick by tick. Compares every HUD number with state.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, victory) and check what is shown, which buttons exist, and whether each visible button is clickable and not covered.
personas.style: Stops at each dialog and inspects ui entries for text, visibility and top. Clicks each visible button by id (btn-resume, btn-restart, btn-next, btn-retry, btn-again) and checks that hidden buttons do nothing. Confirms that Enter activates the main button of each dialog.

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
Lives stay between 0 and 5 (maximum 5 lives).
Keys are never negative.
The HUD Score shows the current score.
The HUD Lives shows the current lives.
The HUD Keys shows the current keys.
The HUD Coins n/5 shows the current coin count.
The HUD Time shows the ticks left on the timer.
The dash status shows 'Dash ready' at 0 and 'Dash n' with the ticks until ready otherwise.
A dash sets the recharge to 6.
The dash recharge drops by 1 at the end of every running tick and never goes below 0.
The timer drops by 1 at the end of every running tick.
When the timer reaches 0 you lose a life and the timer resets to 300.
While paused nothing moves: player, enemies, timer, dash recharge and toasts are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.enemies == prev.state.enemies && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast

checks.rule: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored (e.g. pause+left does not move).
The player makes at most one move (a step or a dash) per tick, in a straight line, at most 2 tiles.
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: The player never stands on a wall or a closed gate.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && (cur.state.gateOpen || tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '=')

checks.rule: Enemies move at most one tile per tick (one tile every other tick).
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

checks.rule: After losing a life you reappear at the start (1,1) and keep all collected items.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == 1 && cur.state.player.y == 1 && cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.keys >= prev.state.keys

checks.rule: Enemies cannot hurt you during the invulnerable ticks; a hit only happens when invulnerable is 0.
Spikes cost one life and 500 points, with the score floored at 0 (spikes hurt even when invulnerable).
checks.expect: cur.state.score == max(0, prev.state.score - 500) && cur.state.lives == max(0, prev.state.lives - 1)

checks.rule: Each coin gives +100 score and +1 coins.
Coins, keys and hearts collected stay collected; they only reset on a restart.
Walking into a locked door with a key opens it and uses exactly one key.
Restart level puts everything back: score 0, 3 lives, 0 coins, 0 keys, timer 300, and the game is running.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
checks.expect: cur.state.bonus == 10 * cur.state.timeLeft && cur.state.score == min(999999, prev.state.score + cur.state.bonus)

checks.rule: While a completion or game-over dialog is open nothing in the world moves.
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.score == prev.state.score

checks.rule: The pause menu shows Resume and Restart level, and each visible button is clickable (not covered).
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-resume' && u.visible && u.top) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-restart' && u.visible && u.top)

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
At 0 lives the game is over and the Game over dialog shows a Retry button.
checks.expect: cur.state.mode == 'gameover' && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-retry' && u.visible && u.top)

value.notes: Round 3 finding: spikes at low score push score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0. Seed 7: 100 -> 65136 on a dash-right spike hit. Seed 1234: 100 -> 65136 on a walk spike hit. 65136 = 65536 - 400, so the score seems to wrap as unsigned 16-bit (100 - 500 = -400). This is a score_overflow bug and violates the floor-at-0 rule in section 5. HUD matches state every tick, so this is not a display desync. Earlier rounds never hit spikes below 500 score, so the floor was never exercised. Seed 42 exit route is untested: goto:12,7 was unreachable without the door. Expected route: key (4,5), then (10,5), then down into door (10,6), then exit (12,7). Still open: time bonus at completion, timer reset at 0 (deferred), 5-life cap (untestable on this map).

verdicts.title: Dash recharge reads 5 right after dash (false positive)
verdicts.observed: After dash-right the state shows dashCooldown=5 and HUD 'Dash 5'. The recharge is set to 6 and decremented at the end of the same running tick.
verdicts.expected: Doc section 3 says a dash sets recharge to 6 and that right after a dash the HUD shows 'Dash 5'. The check expects 6 and misreads the design, so this is not a bug.

verdicts.title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
verdicts.observed: While paused at tick 18, btn-resume is visible but top=false (not the topmost element at its centre). The 'Key collected' toast is still visible and sits over it, so a click on Resume would not reach the button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it (section 7).

verdicts.title: Two movement keys in one tick both move the player (diagonal move)
verdicts.observed: Tick 3 'down+right' moved the player from (4,2) to (5,3): a diagonal displacement, with events [move,move]. Two movement keys each applied a move.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key in a tick counts; the player makes at most one step, with no diagonal movement (sections 2 and 3). Expected end at (5,2) or (4,3) at most, with one move.

verdicts.title: Pause does not stop the rest of the tick's input
verdicts.observed: 'pause+left' from (2,1) paused the game and still moved the player to (1,1); events were [pause,move].
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (2,1) (section 2).

verdicts.title: HUD Time stale after resume
verdicts.observed: After click:btn-resume the state shows timeLeft=299, but the HUD still displays 'Time 300'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current values, including Time (ticks left) (section 8).

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After esc then click:btn-restart, the event is [restart] but mode remains 'paused' rather than 'playing'. The pause menu stays open.
verdicts.expected: Restart level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (section 7).

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap the score instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: At tick 2 the player had score 100 and hit spikes; score became 65136 (about 100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit). Lives correctly dropped 3 to 2.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so the score should be 0 (max(0, 100 - 500)), never a large positive value.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-300) after spikes and a coin
verdicts.observed: Spikes at tick 3 turned score 100 into 65136, then a coin at tick 6 showed score -300. The score is negative and the coin did not add the expected +100 from a sane base.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative. Spikes floor the score at 0, and a coin then adds exactly +100 to a non-negative score.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused with the pause menu still open
verdicts.observed: After pausing and clicking btn-restart, the state reset to the start (player (1,1), time 300) but mode stayed 'paused' and the pause menu remained visible with Resume and Restart buttons.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', pause menu closed).

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stale after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Level-complete time bonus wraps score to negative (-32746)
verdicts.observed: On completing the level, score was 30200 with a time bonus of 2590 (correct value), but the score became -32746 (32790 wrapped as a signed 16-bit value).
verdicts.expected: Score should be 30200 + 2590 = 32790, never negative and capped at 999,999.

verdicts.title: Finish button covered by the time-bonus banner on level complete
verdicts.observed: At level completion the 'btn-next' (Finish) button reports top=false; the levelup dialog's bonus-banner sits on top of it, so a click there would not reach Finish.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Finish button.

verdicts.title: HUD Time stays at 300 after the first running tick following resume
verdicts.observed: After pause, click:btn-resume, the state reports timeLeft=299 but the HUD still displays 'Time 300'. The HUD remains stale on the following pause too (timeLeft 299, HUD 300).
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current values, so the HUD Time should read 299 once the timer has dropped to 299.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin by dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-down over a coin, state shows coins=1 and the HUD shows 'Score 100' (updated) but 'Coins 0/5' (stale).
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD Coins field shows the current count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-32746) when the level is completed
verdicts.observed: Score was 30200 before the exit step; on completing the level (tick 41) the score becomes -32746 and the HUD shows 'Score -32746', which is then kept on the victory screen.
verdicts.expected: Section 4: score is never negative and is capped at 999,999. The score should be 30200 plus the time bonus (2590), i.e. about 32790, and never below 0.
